image_description: A group of people dancing around a tall wooden pole in a grassy park setting. The pole is topped with a decorative wreath and has numerous long, colorful ribbons (streamers) extending from the top to the ground, held by the dancers who are weaving them into patterns. The scene depicts a traditional May Day celebration.
